back: Creations of the mind (inventions, software, works, brands, designs) that can be owned and protected by law.
Registered right giving an inventor exclusive use of a new, inventive, useful invention for a limited period (usually 20 years).
Protects code, text, images and music automatically; protects the expression, not the idea.
A registered name, logo, slogan or symbol that distinguishes a business's goods or services.
Registered right in the appearance (shape, pattern, lines) of a product, not how it works.
Confidential information that gives an advantage; protected by secrecy and non-disclosure agreements, not registration.
Zimbabwe Intellectual Property Office (ZIPO); ARIPO (headquarters in Harare) for several African countries.
Business registration; tax (ZIMRA); consumer protection; Cyber and Data Protection Act; Copyright Act; employment law; POTRAZ licences; council trading licences.
Keep it secret; use NDAs; search existing rights; register patent, design and trademark; use licences; monitor and act against copying.
